# DisasterAWARE

> DisasterAWARE Enterprise is a global disaster, severe weather and threat intelligence provider built on Pacific Disaster Center (PDC) technology. It delivers real-time hazard events, authoritative warnings, observed hazard footprints, exposure and impact intelligence across 30+ hazard types, plus an enriched historical catastrophe archive, through APIs, MCP servers for AI applications, geospatial data layers and the DisasterAWARE Enterprise platform.

DisasterAWARE serves insurers and reinsurers, risk intelligence and security teams, supply chain and logistics operators, business continuity teams, government and humanitarian organizations, and technology and data partners, as well as individuals monitoring homes, family and properties. Developers and AI applications can reach the same intelligence through the Disaster & Severe Weather API, the historical catastrophe datasets and two MCP servers (historical catastrophe intelligence and live disaster intelligence).

## Products

- [AI & Analytics Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/ai-analytics-intelligence): AI-powered risk analytics and early warning: feed AI agents, copilots and data lakes with real-time hazards, catastrophe history and exposure intelligence.
- [Custom Hazard Exposure Reports](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/custom-reports): A daily report built around your own sites: which are inside a hazard's alert area, newly affected, moving closer or clear again. See a sample.
- [Real-Time Disaster & Severe Weather API](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/disaster-weather-api): Real-time hazard event API for disasters, severe weather, wildfires, floods, earthquakes and operational risk: REST, webhooks and streams for apps and agents.
- [Earthquake Data — Historical Records, ShakeMap Intensity & API](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/earthquake-data): Earthquake data you can build on: 73,700+ global records with magnitude, depth and timing, plus USGS ShakeMap intensity on major events. Free samples.
- [DisasterAWARE Enterprise Platform](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/enterprise-platform): The fastest way to operationalize disaster intelligence: real-time events, catastrophe history, geospatial layers, AI analytics and workflows in one platform.
- [Flood Data — Historical Records, Gauge Peaks & API](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/flood-data): Flood data you can build on: 108,000+ global flood records back to 1947, US records enriched with USGS gauge peaks, road closures and storm reports.
- [Flood Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/flood-intelligence): Detect floods before official reports: USGS gauges, NWS alerts, satellite data and AI news extraction with injuries, deaths, depth and damage, worldwide.
- [Geospatial Hazard & Risk Data](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/geospatial-hazard-data): 300+ hazard, weather and risk geospatial layers as tiles, WMS, WMTS and vector: forecasts, climate, exposure and infrastructure. Mapbox and Leaflet ready.
- [Historical Catastrophe Data](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/historical-catastrophe-data): Historical catastrophe data API: tornado paths, hail swaths, hurricane wind fields, earthquake ground motion, wildfire perimeters and flood extents.
- [Hurricane Data — Best Tracks, Wind Radii & Landfalls](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/hurricane-data): Hurricane, typhoon and cyclone data: IBTrACS best tracks with quadrant wind radii, per-landfall intensity and Saffir-Simpson history. Free sample, live API.
- [Natural Disaster API — Real-Time Alerts & Historical Data](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/natural-disaster-api): A natural disaster API with real-time verified events and decades of catastrophe history: global coverage, severity and impact attributes, REST and streaming.
- [Severe Convective Storm Data — Hail, Wind & Tornado Records](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/severe-convective-storm-data): Hail, wind and tornado data in one event record: 134,000+ SCS records with measured hail size, wind gusts, MESH radar swaths and surveyed tornado paths.
- [Strike & Protest Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/strike-protest-intelligence): Monitor strikes, protests and civil unrest worldwide in real time, with verified intelligence on disruptions to your supply chain, employees and operations.
- [Tornado Data — Historical Records, Ratings & Real-Time API](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/tornado-data): Tornado data you can build on: 22,500+ US tornado warning and touchdown records since 2014 with EF ratings, footprints and exposure. Free samples and a live API.
- [Tornado Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/tornado-intelligence): Go beyond tornado warnings with verified impact intelligence. Confirm touchdown, track paths, assess damage severity, and identify affected assets in real time.
- [Wildfire Data — US Fire Perimeters, Acreage & Impacts](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/wildfire-data): US wildfire data: 1,900+ fires since 2016 with burned acreage, perimeters, containment timelines, SIT-209 impacts and satellite detections. Free sample.
- [Wildfire Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/wildfire-intelligence): Real-time wildfire risk intelligence beyond perimeters: active fires, smoke impact, evacuation zones and PSPS events from satellites, NIFC and 300+ layers.
- [All product pages, including pricing, use cases and sample datasets](https://www.disasteraware.com/products/llms.txt)

## Solutions

**Enterprise Solutions**

- [Disaster Intelligence for Insurance & Reinsurance](https://www.disasteraware.com/solutions/insurance-reinsurance): Power insurance platforms with global disaster APIs, historical catastrophe data, observed hazard footprints, and AI-ready intelligence for underwriting, claims, and risk analytics.
- [Global Disaster & Security Risk Intelligence APIs](https://www.disasteraware.com/solutions/risk-intelligence-security): Power security platforms and GSOCs with global disaster intelligence, severe weather warnings across 130+ countries, human-induced threats, and AI-ready APIs.
- [Supply Chain Disruption & Disaster Intelligence APIs](https://www.disasteraware.com/solutions/supply-chain-logistics): Power supply chain platforms with global disaster intelligence, severe weather warnings, infrastructure disruption data, geospatial insights, and AI-ready APIs.
- [Business Continuity & Resilience Intelligence APIs](https://www.disasteraware.com/solutions/business-continuity-resilience): Power business continuity platforms with global disaster intelligence, severe weather warnings, hazard exposure data, and AI-ready APIs for operational resilience.
- [Government & Humanitarian Disaster Intelligence APIs](https://www.disasteraware.com/solutions/government-humanitarian): Power government, defense, and humanitarian technology with global disaster intelligence, geospatial exposure, historical catastrophe data, and AI-ready APIs.
- [Disaster & Weather Data Partnerships and APIs](https://www.disasteraware.com/solutions/technology-data-partners): Embed global disaster, severe weather, historical catastrophe, and geospatial intelligence into your products with DisasterAWARE APIs, data feeds, and MCP servers.

**Individuals & Families**

- [Home & Location Disaster Monitoring Alerts](https://www.disasteraware.com/solutions/protect-my-home): Monitor your home and other important places for severe weather and natural disasters. Get email warnings, observed hazard updates, severity, and reported impacts.
- [Family Disaster Monitoring & Severe Weather Alerts](https://www.disasteraware.com/solutions/monitor-my-family): Monitor natural disasters and severe weather near loved ones. Get personalized email warnings, observed hazard updates, severity, and reported impacts.
- [Property Disaster Monitoring & Weather Alerts](https://www.disasteraware.com/solutions/monitor-my-properties): Monitor Airbnb rentals, vacation homes, boats, and multiple properties for disasters and severe weather. Get email warnings, observed hazards, and impact updates.
- [Understand Local Natural Disaster Risk](https://www.disasteraware.com/solutions/understand-local-disaster-risk): Explore natural disaster risks by location. Understand wildfire, flood, earthquake, hurricane, and tornado hazards, historical events, and local risk information.

## Data & Coverage

**Hazard Intelligence**

- [Global Disaster & Hazard Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/all-hazard-types): Explore DisasterAWARE's global intelligence covering 30+ hazard types, including severe weather, wildfires, floods, hurricanes, earthquakes, and operational threats.
- [Global Severe Weather Data & Warning Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/severe-weather): Access global severe weather warnings, forecasts, radar observations, winter storm intelligence, extreme temperatures, and geographic weather risk data.
- [Global Wildfire Data, Detection & Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/wildfires): Access global wildfire intelligence with NASA satellite detections, NIFC, CWFIS, EFFIS, Australian incident feeds, fire perimeters, smoke, and exposure data.
- [Global Flood Data, Inundation & Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/floods): Access flood warnings, early-warning intelligence, river gauge observations, inundation footprints, flood depths, historical flood data, and exposure intelligence.
- [Hail, Wind & Tornado Data | Severe Storm Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/severe-convective-storms): Access hail swaths, estimated hail sizes, damaging wind footprints, tornado tracks, near-real-time severe storm APIs, and historical catastrophe intelligence.
- [Global Hurricane & Tropical Cyclone Data](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/hurricanes-tropical-cyclones): Access global hurricane and tropical cyclone tracks, forecasts, wind radii, intensity, historical IBTrACS records, geographic footprints, and exposure intelligence.
- [Global Earthquake & Tsunami Data, PGA & Shaking](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/earthquakes-tsunamis): Access global earthquake data, magnitude, depth, PGA shaking footprints, tsunami warnings, wave arrival estimates, historical seismic events, and exposure intelligence.
- [Man-Made Threat & OSINT Risk Intelligence API](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/man-made-operational-threats): Access OSINT intelligence on protests, labor strikes, civil unrest, security incidents, transportation disruptions, and geographic operational threats.

**Data Capabilities**

- [Global Warnings & Predictive Hazard Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/warnings-predictive-intelligence): Access global CAP warnings, proprietary flood and landslide early warnings, predictive GIS intelligence, and planned disruption monitoring through DisasterAWARE.
- [Observed Hazard Data & Disaster Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/observed-hazard-intelligence): Access near-real-time observed hazard intelligence, including hail swaths, tornado tracks, wildfire perimeters, flood extents, hurricane winds, and earthquake shaking.
- [Disaster Exposure & Impact Intelligence](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/exposure-impact-intelligence): Connect observed disaster footprints with exposed assets, populations, infrastructure, reported impacts, and historical catastrophe intelligence.
- [Historical Disaster Database & Catastrophe Data](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/historical-disaster-database): Access approximately 680,000 historical disaster events with enriched hazard footprints, severity, cyclone tracks, hail swaths, earthquake shaking, and associated impacts.
- [Global Disaster Data Coverage & Sources](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/global-coverage-sources): Explore DisasterAWARE's global disaster data sources, meteorological warning integrations, satellite observations, historical catastrophe records, and country-by-country CAP coverage.
- [300+ Geospatial Data Layers for Hazards & Risk](https://www.disasteraware.com/data-coverage/geospatial-data-layers): Explore 300+ geospatial intelligence layers covering natural hazards, weather, forecasts, vulnerability, population exposure, infrastructure, and country risk.
